items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1978-12-03
items.q: in this group, they had a Jewish drummer, Jake Goldberg, had a tenor saxophone player whose name was Carl Limburg, and Tim Atkins, an Englishman, was a pianist and leader.

ctx.x: So it was a fairly simple thing, fairly close to the can read.

Albert System clarinet is, of course, it's different from the band system clarinet, in that the band is an improved fingering mechanism. But, Albert is, I don't know, he just seemed to fall into it naturally. Easier to play by here, anybody who has, you'd say a little knack for it. But, I left home, actually, I became interested in playing, we had a little jazz band there in town. They had a band called Tim Shrill, not needed, but Tim Atkins.
